headline: Aaron Donald out, Puka Nacua to play in Rams' game vs. Eagles
summary: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald will not play against the Eagles as he deals with back soreness, while wide receiver Puka Nacua will return from a hip injury after missing the past two games.

headline: 49ers owner Jed York suspended six games, fined $500K by NFL
summary: 49ers owner Jed York has been suspended for six games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy stemming from his August arrest after he tried to engage in prostitution in Ohio.

headline: Ravens' Trey Hendrickson has surgery on finger, out vs. Titans
summary: The Ravens will be without top pass rusher Trey Hendrickson against the Titans on Sunday after the outside linebacker had surgery for a broken finger.

headline: Texans get WR Nico Collins (hamstring) back vs. Cowboys
summary: The winless Texans got good news Friday as star wide receiver Nico Collins is set to return Sunday from a hamstring injury that forced him to miss Houston's last two games.

headline: Vikings' Justin Jefferson out vs. Dolphins with ankle injury
summary: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson won't play against the Dolphins because of a sprained left ankle, but coach Kevin O'Connell is hopeful he can return in Week 5 vs. the Saints.
